atomicity_claim: Single immutable same-filesystem rename publication; no multi-file transaction claim
consistency_claim: All acknowledged bodies survive the bounded filer-process outage and reconcile through both mounts and three native volume endpoints
replication: 200: one volume copy per each of three logical zones
retries: No application mutation replay; unique next operation after ambiguous error. Native mount retries follow pinned upstream implementation. Read transport errors are observed and retried; wrong bodies and unexpected missing ACKs fail.
fault_expectation: Both filer processes exit 137; availability errors/stalls allowed during ten-second hold, then at least five new ACKs and three full historical read cycles, all old ACKs intact and all three copies verified
